content: .{@-फला@} (1) the three myrobalans taken collectively, namely, Terminalia Chebula, <ab n="Terminalia">T.</ab> Bellerica, and Phyllanthus (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>हिरडा, बेहडा</ns> and आंवळकाठी). Also (2) the three sweet fruits (grape, pomegranate, and date); (3) the three fragrant fruits (nutmeg, areca-nut, and cloves).
